tei:div.tei:p: (1na)chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ bstan bcos gros 'debs bdud rtsi'i phreng ba dang 'dre bzhi rtsad gcod bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ khams gsum ma lus kun tu khyab pa rdo rje'i sku// de nyid las byung thugs rje'i 'phrin las rnam par dag pa yis// lam zhugs sgrub pa po yi tshogs rnams yon tan rab rgyas shing*// rtog bcas byis pa skye bo'i tshogs rnams myur du rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig byin rlabs rta bdun brjid pa'i 'od ltar rab 'bar bas// bdag sogs blo yi mun pa bsal nas sems nyid dwangs pa yi// rgya mtsho che las sangs rgyas yon tan padma gzhon nu'i tshal// rab tu rgyas mdzad gang yin de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// de yi bka' drin rjes dran nas// bdag blo rmu rgod lta bu 'di// yang dag lam du bzhugs pa'i phyir// gros 'debs bdud rtsi'i phreng ba bri// 'o skol da lta dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che ni thob/ bka' brgyud bzang dgu ni gdam du byung*/ bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas lta bu rnams kyis ni rjes su bzung*/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed dang (2na)dbang rnams ni rim pa bzhin thob/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar sdom pa dang dam tshig ni khas blangs/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde dang bstan bcos zab mo mang po ni lta ba dang nyan pa byas/ zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams ni zhus/ dge bshes dang*/ ston pa dang*/ sgom chen dang*/ rnal 'byor par ni khas blangs shing ming btags nas/ tshe 'di la nges par blo ma log par 'dug pa soms dang*/ 'o skol ni grags pa ci snyan/ 'khor ci mang*/ bsod nams ci skye/ nga rang min pa gzhan med pa zhig bya dgos snyam nas/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi skyon bgrang*/ ngan smras dang zur za gtong zhing*/ thos pa nga che/ chos nga mkhas/ gdams pa nga zab/ sgom nga bzang*/ ngas chos la dka' las 'di tsam byas zer zhing*/ rang bstod dang*/ rang 'dod 'ba' zhig sgrub par 'dug pa/ zhe 'dod de lta bu zhig kho na (2ba)yod na/

theg pa chen po a cang yang che ste/ theg pa nyan thos par yang mi 'gro /'jig rten pa dang khyad mi 'dug pa/ de ltar byas pas chos ga na 'ong*/ thos pa che ba dang*/ chos mkhas pa dang*/ gdams ngag zab pa dang*/ sgom bzang po'i dgos pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro dgos pa yin/ rgyud la yon tan skye dgos pa yin/ sman pa mkhas pa na nad 'tsho dgos pa dang 'dra ba yin no// de bas na/ zhe 'dod thams cad blo yi gting nas gtong dgos/ de thams cad la snying po med pa cha med dam/ ched du bsgrubs pa'i grags pa ni/ nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra ste yal nas 'gro// ser snas bsags pa'i nor rdzas ni dbul po'i rgyags dang 'dra ste 'dzad/ rang gi zhe 'dod kyi 'khor bskyangs kyang drin tshur la bgrang du 'ong*/ zang zing gi bsod nams ni bdud kyi slu ba yin/ tshe 'di'i skyid sdug gnyis ni 'chi ba'i nang par rmi lam brjed pa bzhin du 'gro/ zang zing gi nor rdzas ni yong kyin je dgos dang je phangs la 'gro/ 'tsho ba'i zas kyang zhim mi zhim gnyis 'dra mi gtsang ba'i gseb tu 'gro ba yin/ gos kyang bzang na cher sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gro bar 'dug pa/ snying thag pa nas chos shig byed na rnyed pas dga' ba med/ ma rnyed pas mi dga' ba med/ de bzhin du grags ma grags dang*/ bde sdug dang*/ bstod smad rnams la'ang dga' mi dga' med pa zhig dgos/ mdor na/ ltogs pa'am 'khyags pa'am shi yang rung ste/ gnyen po'i chos thams cad hril gyi dril nas chos brgyad kyi steng du gtong dgos/ bla na med pa'i byang chub gtong ri snyam (3na)pa zhig dgos pa la/ 'o skol ni gtso bor lto rgyab gnyis sgrub cing*/ 'di gnyis nga la med thabs med/ de'i zhor la chos bya snyam pa 'dug pa/ rgyags chad dam/ gos ngan nam/ mi la sbyin rgyu med na ngo tsha 'phya 'ong snyam na/ khong na nga rgyal dang khe grags yod pa'i rtags yin/ chos pa bya ba gos bzang na ngo tsha ba/

zhim lto byed na ngo tsha/ chos dang mi mthun pa dang*/ dam pa rnams kyi spyod pa dang mi mthun pa byed na ngo tsha ba yin/ chos gsha' ma zhig byed na dman pa'i sa bzung hrul po'i gos gon/ gnas ri khrod kyi dgon sa 'grim dgos/ lto gos la gyong bskur/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la blo lhan gyis bkal nas/ na na yang khyi na ba ltar 'jog dgos/ shi na yang khyi shi ba ltar 'jog dgos/ nye ba rnams kyi kyang*/ de shi ba dang khyi shi ba gnyis la khyad med zer ba zhig dgos/ mdor na/ rang gi dge sbyor ci 'phel ma gtogs pa pha dang ma'i ngo yang mi srung ba zhig gos/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub pa thob pa rnams kyis/ rgyal srid la sogs pa thams cad mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor nas/ dka' thub dang dka' spyad 'ba' zhig mdzad pas don grub pa sha stag byon 'dug /'o skol da lta'i chos pa rnams ni byas pa med par re ba ched/ ma bsgrubs par 'bras bu 'dod/ chos pa bzang po dang 'dzin chags gnyis ka re/ mi chos dang lha chos gnyis ka 'ong du re/ dka' ba ma spyad par dngos grub thob tu re/ chos gdams ngag zhad re tsam shes kyang rang nyams su mi len par/ zhu mi dang slob ma 'ong du (3ba)re/ zla re zla gnyis ri la bsdad na yang mis thos su re/ bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog byed du re/ sgom nyams sam yon tan zhad re tsam byung na yang 'di la ji ltar byas nas bstan snyam/ chos thun re bshad dam/ gtor ma tshar re btang ngam/ gzhan don bag re byas na 'dis nga la ci ster snyam/ chos sam gdams ngag zhu mi byung na/ nga rang gis kyang 'di tsam phul ba yin/ me tog 'di tsam re 'dod zer ba 'dug pa/ de ni chos btsongs pa'i rin za ba yin na/ 'o skol ni tshong zhig byed na yang rang rgyal bar 'dod/ zas shig za na yang rang che ba dang zhim pa cig za 'dod/ zhag gcig gnyis par yang skyid par nyal 'dod/ zas nor yang bzang dgu thams cad rang tshags byed 'dod/

ngan dgu thams cad mi la ster 'dod/ bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa bas/ rang gi lto rgyab dang*/ nye 'brel la sbyin pa gal che bar byed/ de yang*/ thugs gzo ba'am zab pa rnams kyis kyang*/ kha la mi 'dod pa skad zer nas/ 'dod pa phugs su bcug nas gda' ba/ 'dod pa la blo ma log par chos pa ga na mchi/ legs par soms dang*/ 'o skol ni sngar yang re dogs 'ba' zhig gis phung ba yin/ gros mkhas pa'am/ mi chos gzo ba'am/ mi sems zin pas/ thugs zab pa'am/ pho zo mtho ba kho nas phung pa lags na/ tshe 'di phyi gnyis khrid du byed pa de sgrub phyogs dag che bar gda' ste/ rta gnyis la zhon na thang la lhung bar mchi'o// da phan chad chos brgyad don gnyer gyi mi dang blo ma bstun/ lhan du ma sdod/ kha ma smra/ 'o skol ni thog ma med pa nas dngos 'dzin la goms drags pas/ gnyen pos (4na)gcun yang mi phan par 'dug pa cha med dam/ chos las log pa la cha lugs bor mi dgos/ blo 'dod pa'i phyogs su song ba dang*/ chos brgyad kyi phyogs su song ba la zer ba yin/ mdor na/ rang la rdzun ma zer/ dug ma blud/ mi zer ba la ma nyan/ rna ba dang gros ma byed/ snying thag pa nas chos byed pa'i gros thams cad tshe 'di blos btang ba'i dam pa rnams la dris/ gzhan thams cad kyis chos brgyad slob tu 'ong ba yin/ 'dod pa dang 'dzin pa slob na/ slob dpon yin kyang bdud du shes par bya'o// rang tshe 'di dang ma 'dres pa'i chos gcig byed na/ grags pa snyan rung mi snyan rung*/ bsnyen bkur byung rung ma byung rung*/ rang skyid rung sdug rung*/ bka' brgyud rnams kyi mdzad srol yang 'di yin/ dge sbyor yang 'di 'phel/ chos dang yang 'di mthun/ ci dga' gyis snyam pa zhig dgos pa la/ 'o skol ni/ mi gzhi srab mo yab se yob se/ pho bsol po phyad de phyod de/ pho rgod po re byas pas sgrub pa po ci la 'ong*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ci la 'thob/

grub thob kyi brgyud pa ci la zin/ rje btsun ras chung pas/ bla ma chen po dge sbyor mdzad pa la bar chad ma byung ngam zhus pas/ nga la bar chad 'ong don ci la yod gsung*/ de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ ngas mi'i kha la nyan ma myong gsung skad/ de bas na/ dgon pa bdag tu mi bzung*/ thab ka dang las ka mi bya/ 'khor dang g.yog la mi dga'/ gzhan gyi phye gtor ma 'gam/ mi chen gyi lad mo ma byed/ zang zing gi g.yeng ba mi bya/ gzhan gyi ngo mi srung*/ bud med dang khyu mi sre/ zhing chu dang 'bun skyed mi bya/ (4ba)tshong khe spog mi bya/ bla ma dang yi dam mi blu/ blo phug sprang la gtad/ 'dug sa ri khrod du bya/ smra na rang skyon smros/ bstod na gzhan bstod/ 'dul na rang rgyud thul/ gsog na 'phags pa'i nor bdun la sogs/ spel na nyams myong dang rtogs pa spel/ skyong na bla ma'i gdams ngag skyong*/ lar chos gsha' ma zhig byed na/ mi gzhi la 'gyur ba med pa zhig dgos/ dus rtag tu 'chi grabs byed pa zhig dgos/ dad pa la 'phel 'grib med pa zhig dgos/ mos gus la ltem rkyang med pa zhig dgos/ sems la g.yo sgyu med pa zhig dgos/ dam tshig dang sdom pa mig 'bras bzhin du srung ba zhig dgos/ sems can gcig gi ba spu'i khung bu gcig la yang gnod pa mi skyel gyi steng du/ nus tshad kyis phan 'dogs pa zhig dgos/ ngan smras sam skur pa 'debs mkhan byung na yang*/ khong gi de gdams ngag yin snyam pa zhig dgos/ tshur la gnod pa byed mkhan byung na yang*/ khong gi de gdams ngag yin snyam pa zhig dgos/ tshur la gnod pa byed mkhan byung na yang*/ ngas bzod pa thub mi thub blta ba'i slob dpon yin snyam pa zhig dgos/ khong gi ma shes ma rig pa yin/ nga rang gi sngon gyi drin can ma rgan yin/ khong da lta dngos po'i gdon gyis bzung nas smyo ba yin/ snying re rje/ nga dam pa'i chos byed pa yin snyam du bsam zhing*/ khong gi gnod pa byas pa'i lan du/

'o skol gyi nus tshad kyis phan 'dogs pa zhig dgos/ 'thab rtsod lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dge rtsa ci byas thams cad gnod pa byed mkhan des dbu byas pa'i nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du (5na)bsngo dgos/ mdor na/ zhe sdang ni/ theg pa chen po par nam yang gnang ba'i skabs med pas/ bzod pa la nan tan bya dgos/ rang nyid gsod kyang rgyud 'khrug mi rung na/ longs spyod 'phrog pa dang*/ phyar ka gtong ba la rgyud 'khrug pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ 'o skol ni gos mar bsrings/ skra yang bstungs nas 'dir kha bskyed de gzhan la gnod pa byed pa mi 'tshal/ gral dmas sam/ bsnyen bkur chung ngam/ ma legs sam/ ma shes pa tshul dang mi mthun pa zhad re tsam byung na/ khyed kyis cir mthong*/ nga mi chen po la brnyas pa byed zer nas ko long dam par gda' ba/ chos mang du shes shing nga rgyal je chung*/ yun ring bsgom zhing nga rgyal je chung la 'gro dgos pa yin na/ chos nga rgyal gyi grogs su btang bas ci la phan yon tan zhad re tsam yod pas nga rgyal nas/ nga'i yus kyis gzhan las 'phya bar gda' ste/ de tsug byas pas chos ga na mchi/ 'o skol chos pa yin zer nas/ chos dpe cha la bzhag /rgyud tha mal du bzhag /sems 'dod pa'i nang du bzhag nas/ lag len mi chos la byed/ bzlas brjod ngan sngags la byed/ dge sbyong rkyen zlog la byed/ mchod pa bu smad dang nye 'brel la 'bul/ gtor ma lha 'dre la gtong*/ sgrub pa chos brgyad la byed cing chos pa'i gzugs brnyan du byas nas gda'/ chos nas de ltar du bshad de byed mkhan su yang med zer nas/ gzhan skyon sha stag 'chad par gda' na/ 'o na chos sgor zhugs nas ci byed/ chos nyan nas ci byed/ dpe bris nas ci byed/ de thams cad don med la song ba yin/ 'o skol ni/ rang la yon tan med (5ba)pa'i nyams myong gzhan la bkal nas/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi yon tan khyad du gsod cing*/

bden mi srid rdzun zer ba yin/ 'o na de re sla zer nas gda' ste/ gang zag gi blo tshod mi shes/ dam pa su yin mi shes/ sprul pa yin nam yang mi shes pas na/ chos dang gang zag gi zhal che mi bcad/ thams cad la mos pa bya/ rjes su yi rang 'bul/ khong thams cad ngo mtshar can du 'dug pa la/ nga rang kho na skyug re bro snyam du bsam/ zas nor yang gces dgu thams cad bla ma dang*/ dkon mchog gi phyogs su btang zhing*/ btang snyam pa'i nga rgyal med pa zhig dgos/ 'o skol ni/ rang kho na gtong phod che/ 'dod pa chung*/ mi bzang*/ chos pa bzang snyam nas/ rang la gzhan gyis phye gtor zhad re tsam btang ba la bden nam snyam nas/ nga la thams cad byams/ nga la thams cad mgu snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyis thams cad phung ba lags pas/ nga rgyal de lta bu zhig khong na yod na/ yon tan skye mi srid pas/ nga rgyal gyi ri bo rmang nas bsgyel nas/ shes pa dma' zhum gyis gtong ba zhig dgos/ bdag 'dzin gyi mkhar po rmang nas bshig nas shes pa 'dzin med kyi thang la phyam gyis gtong ba zhig dgos/ zhe 'dod kyi mdud pa thams cad khrol gyis 'gro ba zhig dgos/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog thams cad lhan gyis zhi ba zhig dgos/ snang ba 'di dngos bun la sangs kyis 'gro ba zhig dgos/ rang rgyud kyi shes pa gnyen lcug gis 'gro ba zhig dgos/ stan thog tu lhan ne sdod tshugs pa zhig dgos/ 'gro ba gzhan la snying rje dung gis skyes pa zhig dgos/ mthun 'jug gi rtsig pa rmang nas 'gyel ba zhig (6na)dgos/ chags sdang dang*/ phyogs ris skyes pa'i rgyu thams cad ling nge bor nas 'gro ba zhig dgos/ rang gi dge sbyor dang*/ yon tan ci 'phel gyi grogs dang*/ gnas dang spyod lam 'ba' zhig brten pa zhig dgos/ de thams cad kyang mdor bsdu na/ chos nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por ma song zhing*/ rang gi rgyud la ma phan na sde snod gsum blo la bshad shes kyang*/ ne tso'i 'don pa dang 'dra/

gdams ngag zab dgu thams cad yod kyang*/ sman pa kho rang nad kyis shi ba dang 'dra/ bla ma bzang dgu bsten kyang rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skom pas 'chi ba dang 'dra/ lo brgya stong la sogs ri khrod dam/ phug tu bsdad kyang*/ ri dwags sam/ phyi ba dang 'dra/ bskal pa mang por sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims la 'bad kyang rung*/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa byung yang rung*/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba dang*/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub thob kyang*/ sangs rgya ba'i rgyur 'gro ba tsam las/ 'khor ba'i pha rol tu rgal mi nus/ 'khor ba rgal ba la rang gi sems rtogs dgos/ sems rtogs par byed pa la gdams ngag gcig pus mi phan/ bla ma rtogs ldan zhig gis byin rlabs 'jug dgos/ de 'jug par byed pa la/ bla ma de la lus longs spyod thams cad dngos sam yid kyis 'bul zhing sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed nas/ dad gus rgyun chad med par gsol ba btab cing*/ de la blo lhan gyis gtad la/ des ci gsungs nyan na/ bla ma de'i byin rlabs zhugs nas/ bla ma de'i rtogs pa slob ma'i rgyud la 'char/ de shar ba dang bla ma'i thugs dgongs lon pa zhes kyang bya/ tshig (6ba)gi ma bslad pa thob pa zhes kyang bya/ sgom khrid tshar/ las zin sdug bsngal gyi khur bor/ 'khor ba'i chu bo brgal/ thar pa'i skam sar sleb/ mi zad pa'i gter dang phrad/ rang sems la nges shes skyes pas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong nas mos gus gsha' ma zhig gdod skye/ de skyes pa dang yon tan thams cad nam zla ston ka'i 'bras bu thams cad dus gcig la smin pa'am/ nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du 'byung ngo*// rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa de lta bu zhig rang gi rgyud la skyes pas/ dge bas phan ma btags/ sdig pas gnod ma bskyal snyam nas/ rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod nyen yod pas/ kun rdzob rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don rtogs par bya zhing*/

las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa sangs bar bya ba'i phyir/ da rung bla ma dam pa bsten nas mos gus cher bskyed cing bsgoms pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes nang nas 'char/ de shar ba dang bla mas kyang*/ tshig sban sbun med par 'di rjen par bstan 'dug snyam pa 'byung*/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun nas kyang bstan nas 'dug pa la/ nga rang tsa re long du song nas 'dug snyam pa 'ong*/ spyir tshogs ma rdzogs shing sgrib pa ma byang na/ sems mi rtogs pa sngags dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis ka mthun/ pha rol tu phyin par bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du tshogs bsags nas sangs rgya bar 'dod pa dang*/ sngags nas tshe gcig gis sangs rgya bar 'dod pa yang*/ tshogs gnyis gsog pa dang sgrib pa sbyang ba'i thabs che chung gi khyad par du gda' ba/ dper na gzhung lam chen por skor ba dang*/ gseb lam la 'gro ba dang 'dra/ des (7na)na tshogs gsog pa'i zhing sa yang bla ma kho na bzang bar gsungs/ bla ma la mos gus bcos min re skyes na/ bskal pa mang po'i sgrib pa rtsa ba nas 'dag par gsung*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs shig ma zhugs na/ sems nyid 'di bltas pas mi mthong*/ bzung bas mi zin/ bkag pas mi khegs/ rang gi snang ba 'di yang spangs pas mi spong*/ bshig pas mi shigs/ de bas na/ tshogs gsog par 'dod pa dang*/ sgrib pa sbyang bar 'dod pa dang*/ bar chad zhi bar 'dod pa dang*/ rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba 'dod pa dang*/ snang ba zil gyis gnon par 'dod pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don yongs su rdzogs par 'dod pa rnams kyis/ bla ma kho na la bsnyen bkur bya zhing*/ gsol ba gdab pa gcig pu las med/ rtogs pa skyes pa rnams kyis kyang bla ma la gsol ba btab cing*/ rtogs pa'i mnyam nyid bskyangs pa las/ rang gi sems spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de chos kyi skur thag chod/ tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba 'di thams cad sgyu ma'am/ rmi lam dang 'dra ba thag chod pas/

'khor 'das la re dwogs med/ phyi nang gi sgro 'dogs chod/ sngar ma mthong ma thos pa'i chos thams cad la yang*/ long ba mig bye ba bzhin song bas/ bka' rab 'byams la shes rab kyi snang ba thob/ bla ma dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la thugs dgongs gnyis med kyi ngang la 'dres pas chos la rang byan tshud/ shes bya thams cad kyi bdag por song bas/ gcig shes kun la mkhas pa zhes kyang bya/ rang la zhe 'dod til gyi 'bru tsam yang med pas/ ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje lhug par skyes nas/ phan (7ba)ji ltar byas la btags na/ rtogs pa bu'i rgyud la skyes na snyam pa'i/ mas bu gcig po mthong ba dang 'dra ba zhig 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don byed pa zhes kyang de la bya/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa brtan pa 'gyur ba med pa zhig yod pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ zang zing dang*/ rnyed bkur la mi ltos pa'i 'gro don byed dgos te/ rang gcig pu thar pas mi phan pas/ gdul bya yang gang dman pa/ gang snyoms chung ba/ gang gzugs ngan pa/ gang longs spyod chung ba/ sdig shas che ba thams cad la byams par byed dgos/ khong mi chen dang*/ sgo can gyis chos dang slob dpon gang nas kyang rnyed/ khong bsod nams bsags pa yin pas/ ci ltar byas kyang bde/ 'o na yang*/ gdul bya dus la bab na/ gang mos pa dang*/ gang dad pa che ba la chos dang gdams ngag bya/ mi mos mi dad pa la gdul bya'i las 'brel gzhag /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong legs pa'i skar ma bskyangs pa dang 'dra/ sgyu lus la brten nas 'gro ba mang po ma 'drong kyang*/ snying rje chen po bskyed nas smon lam rgya chen po btab pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can re re'i mdun du yang sprul pa re re ston nus pa 'byung ngo*// rgya gar gyi grub thob thams cad kyis kyang*/ tshogs pa chen po bskyangs par mi gda' ba de/ khong rnams thugs rje chung nas ma bskyangs ba ma lags/

gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la ma bab par gzigs nas/ sprul pas 'gro don mdzad par gda'/ da lta'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'gro don mdzad pa rnams kyang*/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ grub thob rnams kyi sprul par gda'/ (8na)khong rang gis sprul par ma mkhyen pa yang 'gal ba med de/ dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan pos skyes pa dang bud med la sogs pa mang po sprul yang*/ de dag gis bdag ni sgyu ma'i skyes bu'o snyam pa med kyang*/ skye bo thams cad mgu bar byed pa dang 'dra'o// 'o skol gyis sprul par ma mthong ba de rang nyid rnam pa ma dag pas lan pa yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang du byas na/ sprul pas sprul pa mthong ba de/ tshogs lam chen po'i gnas skabs yin par gda'/ sangs rgyas la 'od zer dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa mnga' yang*/ 'o skol gyis ma mthong ba de ltar lags/ des na/ rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi bran bzhin du bya ste/ zas nor la sogs pa phar la yang sbyin/ tshur la yang blangs la smon lam rgya chen po gdab/ skyes bu dam pa de mthong ba dang thos pa dang*/ reg pa tsam yang ngan song dang log par mi 'gro na/ zas nor dang chos 'brel byas pa dang*/ dad gus kyis gsol ba 'debs pa rnams/ de'i gdul byar 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ the tshom med par bya'o// de ltar gzhan don byed pa'i dus su g.yeng ba che snyam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sems khral che snyam par mi bya bar/ gzhan la phan par 'dug na/ nga yi skyid sdug gnyis kyang yal nas 'gro ba yin pas/ nga rang gcig pu skyid pas mi phan snyam du bsams la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ci phan dang*/ 'gro ba gzhan la ci phan 'ba' zhig bya/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum 'gro ba'i don du bsngos la btang ngo*/ spyir yang rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa zhig yin na/ legs nyes dang phan yon thams cad shong ba nam mkha' lta (8ba)bu zhig dgos/

bzang ngan dang skyid sdug thams cad theg pa sa gzhi lta bu zhig dgos/ rgan gzhon che chung thams cad dang 'grogs shes pa bu chung lta bu zhig dgos/ zhen pa nang nas log pa nad pa'i sngas su zas bzhag pa lta bu zhig dgos/ snying rje shugs 'byung du skye ba ma bu gcig pu mthong ba lta bu zhig dgos/ yon tan thams cad shugs 'byung du skye ba dbyar gyi sa gzhi lta bu zhig dgos/ dngos 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa zhig pa chab rom chu ru zhu ba lta bu zhig dgos/ nyam nga bag tsha med pa seng ge gangs la mchong ba'am/ glang po che mtshor zhugs pa lta bu zhig dgos/ yon tan de lta bu 'byung ba la rtogs pa shar ba tsam gyis mi chog /spyod pa ro snyoms pa la slob dgos/ ro la gzhan snyoms rgyu med/ chos brgyad ro snyoms dgos pa yin/ 'o skol thog ma med pa nas dngos 'dzin la goms drags pas/ sgom skyes rtogs pa shar yang gsar bu song bas/ dngos 'dzin bzlog mi nus pa lags/ dper na nyi ma shar ma thag mun pa sangs kyang*/ chab rom zhu mi nus pa dang 'dra/ nyi ma tsha zhing yun ring ba zhig shar na/ mun pa sangs ba'i steng du chab rom yang 'ju ba bzhin du/ rtogs pa shar nas de nyid brtan par byed pa la/ pha rol tu phyin pa nas sgom lam zhes bshad/ sngags nas spyod pa'i thabs su bshad/ 'khyer so mi gcig kyang don la gcig pa lags/ rtogs pa shar nas de rang bsgoms pas/ yon tan thams cad kyang gdod rdzogs par 'byung*/ snang ba thams cad kyang chos skur shar/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i ming yang der thob/ 'gro ba gzhan la phan thogs pa yang der 'byung ngo*// de bas na/ rtogs pa (9na)ma skyes pa thams cad kyang*/ rtogs pa skye ba'i thabs/ bla ma la bsnyen bkur bya zhing*/ mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs pa la 'bad pa ma gtogs pa gzhan med/ rtogs pa skyes pa rnams kyis kyang*/ de brtan par byed pa'i thabs la/ bla ma la mos gus bya zhing de nyid la goms par bya/

brtan pa thob pa rnams kyis bdag bsgral nas/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bya/ bdag grol nas/ sems can ma grol ba rnams bsgrol bar bya/ bdag dbugs phyung nas/ sems can dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bya/ bdag mya ngan las 'das nas/ sems can mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i thabs la mkhas par bya/ brtson par bya/ yid skyo ba med par bya'o// sgyu mas sgyu ma'i skyes bu la// gros 'debs sgyu ma'i yi ger bri// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul dpag med pas// sgyu ma'i 'gro kun 'dren par shog /sprul pas sprul pa'i rgyal ba la// sprul pa'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs byas nas// sprul pa'i yon tan rab rgyas shing*// sprul pa'i 'gro kun 'dren par shog /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems can rnams// nam mkha'i ngang la dag nas kyang*// nam mkha' gang ba'i yon tan gyis// nam mkha'i 'gro kun 'dren par shog /sems la gros 'debs/ mtshang skyon thams cad yul nas 'don par byed pa/ rang skyon lta ba'i me long*/ gros 'debs bdud rtsi'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'o// ༈ //

chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung sgros/ 'dre bzhi rtsad gcod bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams (9ba)la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dre bzhi rtsad gcod pa'i gdams pa 'di la don gnyis/ 'dre rtsad gcod pa dang*/ de la gnad du bsnun pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ lhun gyi grub pa'i 'dre/ srid pa khungs kyi 'dre/ rnam par rtog pa'i 'dre/ mi las gyur pa'i 'dre'o// dang po ni/ srid pa'i mes po lha tshangs pa'am/ sa bdag 'phags pa la sogs pa/ gdon thams cad kyi mes po lta bu yin zer te/ srid pa'i mes po bas/ sa rdo ri brag kyang med par 'gro la/ med par 'gyur pas/ de bas na/ srid pa'i mes po bya ba zhig yod na dag mi srid pa gang yang med/ med pa zhig yin ce na/ dngos po med pas gang gis kyang gnod mi srid pas des na/ lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dre mi bden pas 'dre med do// srid pa khungs kyi 'dre ni/ pha ma las byung ba'i mgon po dang*/ lha mo dang*/ rgyal po la sogs pa yin zer te/ srid pa gsum po 'di yang mi bden na/ pha ma dang*/ bu tsha bya ba gang na yang grub pa med pas/ srid pa khungs kyi 'dre mi bden par thag bcad do// rnam par rtog pa'i 'dre ni/ mo ma dang*/ mig mthong mkhan po la sogs pas/ mi ma shi bar 'dre ru bzung nas gnod par 'dug zer ba lta bu dang*/ yang rtog pa gcig gis gcig la gnod pa byas kyang*/ rtog pa dngos por med pas/ phan gnod dang bde sdug mi 'ong ste/ rnam par rtog pa'i 'dre mi bden na gang yang med do// mi las gyur pa'i 'dre ni/ mo ma la sogs pa na re/ shi ba thams cad phan gnod byed pa'i 'dre ru skye ba yin zer te/ de ltar yin na/ lha shi ba'i 'dre dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro la sogs pa yang 'drer skye dgos te/ de skad zer ba mi 'dug pa dang*/ (10na)yang mi shi ba thams cad 'drer skyes na/ 'gro ba rigs drug gzhan yod par mi rigs te/ thams cad 'dre'i rigs su 'gro bar rigs te/

mi bden/ nges par 'dre gzugs su grub pa can zhig yin na/ sus mthong*/ gzugs med zhig yin na/ nam mkha' des su la gnod/ gang la gnod/ de ltar na 'dre bas/ sangs rgyas kyang ming du btags pa tsam las/ dngos por grub pa med do// de yang lung las/ sems nyid kun tu bzang po la// gnod par bya ba'i rgyu yang med// mtho ris med cing ngan song med// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// lha yang med cing 'dre yang med// bdud kyang med cing bgegs kyang med// gal te don 'di ma rtogs na// dper na nam mkha'i skar ma 'dra// nam mkha' nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// nyi zla gza' skar bkram pa 'dra// chos kyi dbyings la bzang ngan med// kun bzang gnas la yangs dog med// ye shes thugs la 'phel 'grib med// ces gsungs so// de dag thams cad bsdus pas gnyis su 'dus te/ de yang gdon dang*/ gdon chen po gnyis so// dang po'i 'dre gdon thams cad rnam par rtog pa yin te/ de ji ltar yin na/ lus 'di la gti mug gi rtsa rlung yod/ de la gti mug rtogs pa rgyu/ de klu gdon yin/ de bzhin du/ zhe sdang gi rtsa rlung yod/ de las zhe sdang gi rtogs pa rgyu/ de btsan dang pho gdon yin/ yang 'dod chags kyi rtsa rlung yod/ de las 'dod chags kyi rtogs pa rgyu/ de bsen mo dang mo gdon yin no// de ltar na/ dug gsum gyi rtog pa gtan nas med na/ gdon gnas pa'i sa med do// gdon thams cad rnam par (10ba)rtog par 'dus so// gnyis pa gdon chen po ni/ snyam byed kyi rtog pa che phra mo la/ nad gdon rags pa'i rtog pa las grol yang*/ da rung yang*/ na ba 'ong ngam/ 'dre gnod 'ong ngam/ snyam pa'i lkog gyur gyi rtog pa phra mo de ngos bzung la gcod do// de ltar yang*/ nā ro pas/ nad dang gdon gyi bar gcod kyang*// bsdu na rnam par rtog par 'dus// na na'ang rtog pa de nyid na// gnod na'ang rtog pa de nyid gnod// 'chi na'ang rtog pa de nyid 'chi// skye na'ang rtogs pa de nyid skye// bde dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa// thams cad rnam par rtog pa ste// sems la ci yang yod ma yin// rtog pa'i gzhi rtsa chod gyur na// nad gnod 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas/

'dre bya ba zhig gang na yang med/ yod na 'dre'i yul 'di yin bya ba'am/ 'dre'i ro 'di yin bya ba la sogs pa gang yang med pas rtog pa la dpyad/ rtog pa la rang bzhin ga la yod de/ med par thag chod pa yin te/ gnyis pa de la gnad du bsnun pa ni/ de ltar 'dre med pa la/ 'drer 'dzin na rtog pa la 'di ltar gnad bsnun par bya ste/ lus ci bder gnas par byas la/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ rang yi dam lhar wal gyis bsgom/ bla ma dang dkon mchog spyi bor bsgom la mos gus kyis mchod cing*/ 'dre rtogs las grol bar gsol ba mang du gdab/ 'drer snang gi rtog pa de rang sems gnyis med kyi ngang la ma bcos par bzhag /de ltar phur tshugs rgyun chad med par bsgom par bya'o// de ltar 'dre ltar snang ba de/ snang ba rang sems su shes/ shes pa stong pa/ de ltar snang sems dbyer med pas 'drer snang ba la/ kho'i yul 'jigs pa'i snang ba 'byung*/ rnal 'byor pas (11na)'dre chos skur rtogs pa'i nyams rtogs 'char bar 'gyur ro// de ltar yang*/ nā ro pas/ rgyun chad med pa'i gsol ba gdab// ltem rkyang med par nyams su blang*// gang yang yid la mi bya bar// lam khar bor ba'i ro bzhin du// lus kyi bdag 'dzin bor byas la// 'dzin med nam mkha'i ngang la bzhag /ces gsungs pa'i don no// yang de la blo ma nges pas/ 'dre lhar khyer ba ni/ rang nyid yi dam gang yin du bsgoms pa'i thugs kar sa bon bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ gnod byed mdun du bkug nas yi dam lhar bsam/ rang gi sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ gnod byed la phog pas/ de'i sdig pa dang gnod sems ma rungs pa thams cad 'od zer gyi tshogs chen pos lhan lhan zhi bar bsam la/ yi dam lha'i nga rgyal chen po dang ldan pas sngags drag tu bzlas pa bya'o// de ltar bsgoms pas/ 'dre'i gnod sems zhi bar 'gyur ro// de ltar yang nā ro pas/

res 'ga' nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar// gzugs sku'i rang bzhin shes byas la// thogs med rdo rje lta bu'i skus// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams gang*// mkha' la grags pa'i brag cha ltar// sgra yi rang bzhin shes byas la// gsang sngags rdo rje'i 'brug sgra dang*// 'od kyis nam mkha' gang bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// de ltar na/ 'dre dge sbyor gyi skul 'debs dang*/ lcag 'debs dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen du khyer bar bya'o// de yang*/ ri khrod dang gnyan sa 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ lus kyi gnad cha glod/ ngag gi gnad sngags dang*/ phaṭa phaṭa dang bag yangs bya/ sems kyi gnad 'du shes bshig /shes pa (11ba)sos gdal/ ngos bzung med par mi ro'am/ sa rdo bzhin du bor la/ ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag go /de'i tshe/ dus thams cad du gnyid kyang 'od gsal du gzhug /'od gsal du ma tshud na'ang gnyid ro bzhin log par bya'o// yang yang bsgoms pas mngon du 'gyur/ sems rtog bzang ngan ci byung yang*// ma bcos rang sar grol bar nges// 'dre rtog gzhom pa'i gdams pa/ 'dre bzhi rtsad gcod ces bya ba'o// gdams pa 'di dpal gyi stobs lung bya bar/ rje sgam po pa 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i dus su/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul chen po byung bas/ 'khor thams cad gzims spyil gyi tha mar spungs pa'i dus su/ chos 'di gsungs pa yin/ gnas der sbyin sreg chen po mdzad pas lha 'dre thams cad btul ba yin gsung ngo*// ༈ //na mo ratna gu ru/ man ngag gser gyi yang skor la/ don rnam pa lngas bstan te/ snang srid chos nyid du shes pa dang gcig /nam mkha' sems su bzung ba dang gnyis/ kun tu bzang po pha ru shes pa dang gsum/ kun tu bzang mo ma ru shes pa dang bzhi/ snang ba sems su bsdu ba dang lnga'o// de la dang po snang srid chos nyid du shes pa ni/ snang ba la dngos por mi 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa nam mkha' sems su bzung ba ni/

sems nyid dngos po med par sang nge ba de yin/ gsum pa kun tu bzang po pha ru shes pa ni/ chags sdang dang bral ba'o// bzhi pa kun tu bzang mo ma ru shes pa ni/ sems rang lugs su phab pa la mi dmigs mi rtog pa'o// lnga pa snang ba sems su bsdu ba ni/ 'di ltar snang ba (12na)thams cad sems nyid dngos po med cing ma 'khrul par shes tsa na snang ba thams cad der 'dus so// man ngag gser gyi yang skor zhes bya'o// sems kyi gzer zhes kyang bya'o// yang dag par rdzogs so// rin po ches gsungs pa lags so/// /maṅga laṃ bha wantu//
